rationale: Both assets undercut their established post-capitulation lows and then produced an immediate high-participation reclaim above the 20-day structure. That is qualitatively different from simply buying oversold weakness and supports re-entry. However, both are coming off a single vertical recovery candle with 50-day resistance immediately overhead, so use meaningful spot exposure but no 2x chase. Failure back below the reclaimed zone invalidates the spring thesis.
